temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After their coffee conversation, Sara believed Shirley felt responsible and was grieving, and that Shirley was having difficulty accepting reassurance.

temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After the apology, Sara believed Shirley was still healing and that their friendship and support were intact, but she was unsure how much Shirley had actually improved.

temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is recovering, values her support, and is open to a closer friendship; continued support and shared time may help further.
